scope: disposable loopback PostgreSQL; actual native refund/order APIs, duplicate/parallel attempts and candidate existing-record recovery; provider responses are fixtures; initial native workflow and real Stripe Sandbox are not verified
checks: a repeated native refund for the same allocation is rejected by the unique index before the fixture provider callback
concurrent actual native order debit attempts have one winner; incorrect cents are rejected before booking
actual candidate recovery validates current native payment/refund/capture and reuses the one existing correct debit without further Stripe funds requests
settled native refund money/association/deletion and order-debit deletion/soft deletion are rejected without rewriting historical records
both bookkeeping guards remain private invokers with no browser/service-role execute grants
